metadata.scenario: A new customer disputes a billing error where they were charged twice for the same service. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute. Customer type: new_customer.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How may I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Karen Lewis. I was referred by my husband's cardiac surgeon's office for post-operative care. Hi Karen, it’s nice to speak with you. How can I help with your husband's care? Well, I received a bill and I'm a bit confused. It looks like we were charged twice for the same service. Oh, I’m sorry to hear that. Can you provide me with the details of the charges? Yes, I have a charge for post-surgery recovery care dated last week and another one for the same service on the same day. Thank you for sharing that. Let me pull up your file and verify those charges. One moment, please. Alright, I see the charges you're referring to. It appears there was an error on our end. You should only have one charge for the post-surgery recovery care. I thought so! I appreciate you checking. So, how do we fix this? We will issue a refund for the duplicate charge, and I will make sure to confirm this with our billing department. That sounds good. How long will the refund take? It typically takes 3-5 business days to process. I’ll put a rush on it for you. Thank you, I’d really appreciate that. Of course! Is there anything else I can assist you with regarding your husband’s upcoming care? Yes, can you tell me more about the post-surgery recovery care? Certainly! Our post-surgery recovery care service is priced between $85 to $110 for 1-3 hours, depending on the level of care needed. That sounds reasonable. Can we schedule that for the week after his surgery? Yes, what day will he be discharged? He’s scheduled for surgery on the 15th, so he should be discharged the 16th or 17th. Great! I recommend scheduling for the 17th to ensure he has the right support. Sounds perfect. Can we confirm that appointment? Yes, let me schedule that for you. I’ll also follow up with a confirmation email. Thank you. I really appreciate your help today, Margaret. You’re welcome, Karen! And I’ll make sure to get that billing issue resolved right away. Okay, sounds good. Have a great day! You too, take care!
